description: A dramatic narrative title card with white text on black background reading '──　その日僕は、神を捨てた。' which translates to 'That day, I abandoned God.' — a story-relevant scene/chapter title card.

description: A narrative prose passage in white text on a black background: '──僕は思い出す。あの夏の日、光り輝く緑の丘を。' which translates to 'I remember — that summer day, the radiant green hill.'

regions.text_en: ——I remember it still. That summer day, and the brilliantly glowing green hill.
